hypothesis: A single explicit actor-context-action representation may separate actual choices from reported/hypothetical/output instructions better than independent gates, with fewer calls.
scope: Developer-authored exploratory test, not independent blind acceptance. A combined old gates uses 3 calls; B frame parser uses 1. This compares complete experimental approaches, not prompt-only effects.
releaseGate: All 12 cases correct and no wrong resume; necessary for sandbox testing only.
